sources.title: README.md · CMSManhattan/JiRackUltra_14b at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model was refactored with BitNet features and an updated tokenizer that includes new Routing, Media, Vision, Sound, Tool call, and Robotics tags. Built on a DeepSeek R1-14B architecture with native ternary (BitNet-style) support and ready-to-run GGUF quantizations.
